abstract.p: Using a novel geometric factorization of the singularity set, this paper enumerates all non-generic 3R manipulator geometries. These geometries divide the space of all 3R manipulator geometries into disjoint sets which have similar topological properties. Their enumeration serves as a classification scheme for all 3R manipulators. Some preliminary conjectures on 3R manipulators which can or can not change pose without passing through a singular configuration are presented as one application of these results.
